Welcome

A Touch of Luxury in Oviri-Ogor

Don Angeloz Hotel and Suites is your home away from home in Ughelli, Delta State. From the moment you arrive, you are welcomed with warm, attentive service and an atmosphere designed for rest, business and celebration.

With beautifully finished rooms, a restaurant, VIP bar and outdoor lounge, we make every stay and every occasion feel exceptional.
